cpp/01-namespaces-free-functions.note: some namespace-qualified free-function calls are missed (calls into a nested namespace, ::global calls, an overload calling another)

cpp/03-constructors.note: delegating constructor calls (: Circle(…)) get no edge

cpp/06-callbacks.note: calls through a function-pointer parameter written (*op)() get no edge

cpp/10-code-outside-functions.note: calls in instance field initializers have the file as caller instead of Type#field, and the implicit <init> edge is missing

cpp/11-c1-cross-file-identity.note: a call through a reference parameter to a method declared in a header is missed

cpp/13-not-calls.note: calls through a pointer-to-member ((w.*method)()) get no edge

cpp/16-gap-operator-call.note: operator() on typed objects is not T#operator()

cpp/18-gap-local-typedef-namespace-call.note: function-local typedefs are not expanded (C#inc instead of scene.Counter#inc)

csharp/07-typed-receivers.note: receivers bound by is-patterns (x is Item matched) stay low

csharp/08-interface-abstract-bounds.note: type parameters with a where-bound are named T#m, not the bound

csharp/09-local-functions-lambdas.note: a lambda bound to a local is not a named nested function

csharp/11-multiline-chain.note: calls on a call result whose declared return type is in the scan stay .m low

csharp/15-gap-null-conditional-target-ne.note: target-typed new() gets no constructor edge

csharp/16-gap-delegate-fields-arrow-gett.note: calls through delegate fields are methods (T#f) instead of callbacks

elixir/03-alias-order-and-nesting.note: a nested defmodule alias applies before its defmodule line (aliases are lexical, in source order)

go/07-builtins-casts-not-calls.note: a call through a method value (bark := d.Bark; bark()) is named Dog#Bark medium instead of the callback rule

go/14-gap-generic-types.note: calls into scanned generic types are medium, not high

go/15-gap-package-var-init.note: calls in package-level var initializers get no edges (SPEC Decisions 2026-10-29 requires caller pkg.init)

go/16-gap-typecheck-failure.note: a Go package that fails to type-check is not graphed; the coverage note go_package_load_error says so

groovy/05-typed-receivers.note: type parameters with a bound are named T#m, not the bound

groovy/06-dynamic-low-guesses.note: a bare call not defined anywhere in the scan is Type#m medium instead of a low guess

groovy/09-enum-constants.note: enum constant declarations get no Enum#<clinit> → Enum#<init> edge

groovy/14-gap-getter-and-typed-field-cha.note: receivers typed by an explicit getter or a typed field chain stay low

javascript/14-workspace-vendor-reexport.note: vendor/ directories are skipped by design (coverage note "skipped"); a call into vendor/ code is therefore medium and vendor/ edges are absent

kotlin/01-classes-methods.note: secondary-constructor delegation : this(…) gets no edge

kotlin/04-inheritance-super.note: secondary-constructor : super(…) / : this(…) delegation gets no edge

kotlin/14-invoke-and-factory-functions.note: companion operator invoke is reported as a constructor

objc/03-typed-receivers.note: typedef aliases of class types are not expanded; @catch parameters are untyped

objc/05-parameterless-member-receiver.note: receivers that are parameterless message results stay .m low

objc/07-protocol-typed-id.note:
receivers typed id

by a property or ivar stay low

objc/11-file-scope-code.note: [[T alloc] init] in .mm class methods gives .init low; file-scope macro uses in .m get no edge

objc/13-cross-file-identity.note: a C function call in another .m file is missed

ocaml/04-applying-parameters.note: calls through a record field holding a function (t.on_event x) get no edge

ocaml/14-known-gap-class-methods.note: OCaml classes/objects: methods have no caller IDs and no call edges

php/06-parameterless-return-type.note: receivers that are parameterless method results with a declared return type stay .m low

php/11-top-level-code.note: receivers typed by $x = new T at file top level stay low

php/12-not-calls.note: PHP first-class callable syntax $this->m(...) is reported as a call

php/13-anonymous-class.note: anonymous-class members are named as methods of the enclosing class instead of folding; no constructor edge for new class extends Base

php/17-gap-trait-method.note: methods from traits resolve to the using class at medium

php/18-gap-parent-outside-scan.note: parent::m() with a parent outside the scan becomes parent.m

python/03-nested-functions-lambdas.note: a lambda bound to a local is not a named nested function (callee is a callback, body folds)

python/13-gap-callable-attributes.note: callable attributes set by a superclass or tuple assignment are methods, not callbacks

ruby/03-top-level-code.note: a call of a top-level def is #name medium instead of the free function

ruby/06-external-ancestry.note: code in a class body has the class as caller instead of the file

ruby/13-gap-proc-call.note: .call on a Proc or lambda is a method call, not a callback; lambdas bound to locals are not named nested functions

ruby/14-gap-struct-new-block.note: methods inside Const = Struct.new do … end blocks get broken IDs (#norm)

ruby/15-gap-bare-new-scoped-const.note: bare new in class methods is a low guess, not Type#<init>

rust/05-callbacks.note: calls through an fn-pointer field ((self.on_click)()) get no edge

rust/15-gap-pattern-bindings.note: receivers bound by match/if-let patterns are untyped

scala/03-inheritance-super.note: a bare call of a member inherited from an external base is a low bare name

scala/12-gap-calls-without-parentheses.note: Scala calls written without parentheses are never emitted (recall)

scala/13-gap-operator-infix-calls.note: Scala symbolic and infix operator calls are never emitted (recall)

typescript/03-known-gap-function-valued-.note: function-valued properties called as this.f() are reported as methods

typescript/05-parameterless-members.note: getters and parameterless methods used as receivers stay low

zig/04-function-aliases.note: function-local const aliases of functions are callbacks, not their target

zig/05-typed-receivers.note: receivers typed by an optional capture or file-scope var stay low

zig/07-callbacks.note: calls through function-pointer fields are methods (T#cb) instead of callbacks

zig/10-file-level-const-initializers.note: calls in file-level const initializers get no edges

zig/12-generic-type-static-init.note: static calls on instantiated generic types (std.AutoHashMap(K, V).init) are .m low
